'''Uzryta of Ledostrov''', originally the '''Baron of Uzryta''', led the [[Pentarchy of Ledostrov]] after the 1942 succession crisis.

== Rise ==

After the [[Count of Litwaldov]] died childless in 1942, the [[Duma of Ledostrov]] failed to elect a new duke. Uzryta and four allied nobles bribed military leaders to storm the Duma. Opposing nobles were imprisoned or executed, and the remaining assembly accepted Uzryta as regent.

== Rule ==

Uzryta refused to allow a normal ducal election and governed through the Pentarchy. His council forced laws through a weakened Duma, drove rapid industrialization, and relied on repression to control unrest.

== Fall ==

After roughly a decade of protest and army dissent, Uzryta ordered military restructuring and purges. When [[Reznikoff of Ledostrov]] and the [[Southern Defense Force of Ledostrov]] moved against the regime, some Duma members attempted to assassinate Uzryta and the other Pentarchs. Uzryta escaped the first attack but was later killed by angry citizens while seeking protection.
